name: After recital 7
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (7 c) To fight against global tax avoidance, Member States could also unilaterally collect the tax deficit of multinationals: the difference between what a corporation pays in taxes globally and what it would have to pay if all of its profits were subject to a minimum tax rate in each of the countries in which it operates. Such a solution could encourage other countries to follow that move and progressively lead to an ambitious global solution.
